the_100_year_sleep.title: The 100-Year Sleep & The Miracle of the Donkey
the_100_year_sleep.description: Two incredible miracles proving Allah's power over time and resurrection.

questions.question: Which Surah in the Qur'an contains the story of the man who slept for 100 years?
In which verse of Surah Al-Baqarah is this story found?
What faithful animal was traveling with the righteous man?
What fresh food did the traveler carry in his basket?
What drink did the traveler bring along on his journey?
When the traveler reached the city in the valley, what did it look like?
options: A busy market full of merchants
A completely destroyed ghost town in ruins

questions.question: How does the Qur'an describe the collapsed buildings of the city?
What question did the traveler ask when he saw the ruins?
options: How will Allah bring this city back to life after its death?
Can I build a house here?

questions.question: Did the traveler ask his question because he doubted Allah?
options: No, he asked out of awe and wonder

questions.question: Where did the traveler sit down to rest?
options: In the shade beside a crumbling wall
On top of a high tree

questions.question: How long did Allah cause the man to remain dead / asleep?
While the man was asleep, what happened to the world around him?
options: A century passed, generations died, and the city was rebuilt

questions.question: When the traveler woke up, how much time did he THINK had passed?
options: A day or part of an afternoon

questions.question: Why did he think only part of a day had passed?
options: The sun was still low in the sky like an afternoon nap

questions.question: Who spoke to the man when he woke up to ask how long he had remained?
How did the traveler feel when told he had slept for 100 years?
What normally happens to fresh milk and fruit left in the desert heat for days?
options: They spoil, sour, stink, and rot

questions.question: What happened to the traveler's food and drink after 100 years?
options: They stayed completely fresh and unspoiled

questions.question: What had happened to the donkey after 100 years?
options: It died and decayed into scattered bones

questions.question: What did the donkey's dry bones do when Allah commanded them?
What did Allah cover the reassembled bones with?
What sound did the donkey make after coming back to life?
Why did Allah show two opposite miracles (fresh food vs. decayed donkey)?
options: To show He can both freeze time and restore decayed life
Because fruit is tougher than donkeys

questions.question: What did the traveler declare when he witnessed this miracle?
options: I want to go back to sleep!
I know that Allah is capable of all things!

questions.question: What does the miracle of the donkey teach us about the Day of Resurrection?
options: That it happens by human science
That Allah can easily resurrect all humans, just like the donkey

questions.question: What does this story teach us about Allah's power over time?
options: Allah controls time completely—He can pause it or accelerate it

questions.question: When we face a situation that feels completely hopeless, what should we remember?
options: Nothing is too hard for Allah, He can bring life to what seems lost

questions.question: What should we do when we have sincere questions about our faith?
options: Ask with humility to learn and strengthen faith

questions.question: Who was the righteous traveler traditionally identified as in Tafsir?
What is the ultimate core message of Surah Al-Baqarah 2:259?
options: Allah has absolute power over life, death, time, and all creation

ibrahim_birds.title: Prophet Ibrahim: The Arrogant King & The Four Birds
ibrahim_birds.description: Two incredible miracles that proved Allah's power over life and death.

questions.question: Who is the main prophet in this story?
What made the king behave so badly?
What did Prophet Ibrahim say Allah can do?
What challenge did Ibrahim give the arrogant king?
options: Bring the sun from the west

questions.question: From which direction does the sun normally rise?
What happened to the king after Ibrahim challenged him about the sun?
options: He was left speechless and stunned

questions.question: What did Prophet Ibrahim ask Allah to show him?
options: How Allah brings the dead back to life

questions.question: Why did Ibrahim ask Allah to show him the miracle of the dead?
How many birds did Allah tell Ibrahim to take?
Where did Allah tell Ibrahim to place portions of the birds?
What happened when Ibrahim called the birds?
options: The birds came flying back to him alive

questions.question: What does Al-Aziz mean when describing Allah?
What does Al-Hakim mean when describing Allah?
What important event does the miracle of the birds remind us of?
What was the arrogant king traditionally named in historical accounts?
